lines.en: label yumispring9:
scene nightsky
sud-den (sədn) {i}adjective{/i} - when a thing happens but you didn’t know the thing was going to happen and now it’s happening.
lines.zh: sud-den (sədn) {i}形容词{/i}——当一件事发生了，而你不知道它要发生，现在它正在发生。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk1
: Onii-chan!
lines.zh: : 欧尼酱！

lines.en: : Either buy something or get out, asshole. I’ve got the right to refuse service to anyone, you know.
lines.zh: : 要么买点东西要么滚，混蛋。我有权拒绝为任何人服务，你知道吗。

lines.en: : Why is there always a horn section in the music for you two?
lines.zh: : 为什么你们俩的配乐里总有一段铜管乐？

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk2
: Horn section?
lines.zh: : 铜管乐？

lines.en: : Not this shit again. Dude’s been hearing fucking theme music for me since the moment he first decided to never leave me alone again.
lines.zh: : 又来了。这家伙从决定再也不放过我的那一刻起，就开始听见跟我有关的主题曲了。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk3
: I have theme music?! I want to hear! What the heck?! You can’t just hold out on me like this!
lines.zh: : 我有主题曲？！我要听！搞什么鬼？！你不能这么吊着我！

lines.en: : Fine. Let me just tap into my brain and-
lines.zh: : 行。让我接入一下我的大脑然后——

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk4
: Yup. There it is.
lines.zh: : 嗯。就是这个。

lines.en: : Wow. That quick?
lines.zh: : 哇。这么快？

lines.en: : Yeah. Now if only I could harness that same method to make myself happy.
lines.zh: : 是啊。要是我能用同样的方法让自己快乐就好了。

lines.en: : On the bright side, you not being able to do that makes me a more important figure in your life as the perfect little sister who exists as a ray of sunshine put here to brighten up all of your days.
lines.zh: : 往好处想，你做不到这一点，反而让我在你生命里更重要了——作为那个完美的小妹妹，就像一束被放在这儿、专门照亮你所有日子的阳光。

lines.en: : That’s nice and all. But I’m going to put Yumi’s theme back on now since I haven’t heard it in a while and it’s kind of nostalgic.
lines.zh: : 说得是挺好的。不过我现在要把 Yumi 的主题曲放回去，因为我有一阵子没听了，还挺怀旧的。

lines.en: : You’d think talking to the girl you watched grow up would be a little more nostalgic, but okay.
lines.zh: : 你跟一个看着长大的女孩说话，本来该更怀旧一点吧，不过行吧。

lines.en: : Still waiting on you to buy something.
lines.zh: : 还在等你买东西。

lines.en: : How much for your hairpin?
lines.zh: : 你的发夹多少钱？

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk5
: IT’S NOT FOR SALE!
lines.zh: : 不卖！

lines.en: : Why not? It’s not even doing anything. Like, what are you trying to hold in place? Your hair is straight.
lines.zh: : 为什么不？它根本没在起作用啊。比如，你想固定住什么？你头发是直的。

lines.en: : It’s a fucking decoration, okay?!
lines.zh: : 这是他妈的装饰品，好吗？！

lines.en: : Yeah, Onii-chan. Yumi just wants to look cute and we should let her exercise her self-expression in order to achieve that goal.
lines.zh: : 就是啊，欧尼酱。Yumi 只是想看起来可爱一点，我们应该让她自由表达自己，去实现那个目标。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk6
: Like I give a fuck about looking cute! Now, you buy something too or I’m kicking you both out! You’re off the clock, aren’t you?!
lines.zh: : 我他妈的才不在乎可不可爱！现在，你也买点东西，不然我把你们俩都轰出去！你已经下班了吧？！

lines.en: : I am! And I’m also not convinced you aren’t lying to me right now because girls don’t decorate their hair with cute little pins to look more intimidating or whatever it is you’re going to pretend to want instead!
lines.zh: : 我下班了！而且我也不信你现在没在骗我，因为女生才不会用可爱的小发夹装饰头发，好让自己看起来更有威慑力，或者随便你想假装想要的什么东西！

lines.en: : Still waiting on a price. I need it for my Yumi collection.
lines.zh: : 还在等报价。我的 Yumi 收藏需要它。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk7
: What else do you fucking have of mine?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈的还有我什么东西？！

lines.en: : Your first kiss.
lines.zh: : 你的初吻。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk8
: On second thought, I just quit.
lines.zh: : 我想了想，我辞职了。

lines.en: : Why?! There’s nothing wrong with being kiss-cousins! Onii-chan took mine too! {i}And{/i} my sister’s! And your best friend’s!
lines.zh: : 为什么？！亲吻表亲什么的{i}又{/i}没问题！欧尼酱也拿走了我的！还有我姐的！还有你闺蜜的！

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk9
: Actually, probably your entire floor now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : 这么说起来，大概你整层楼都被他拿走了。

lines.en: : You tryin’ to say there are still survivors on the second floor?
lines.zh: : 你是在说二楼还有幸存者？

lines.en: : Otoha is a hard nut to crack, Yumi. Also, Tsuneyo was weird and I don’t think that one counts.
lines.zh: : Otoha 是块难啃的骨头，Yumi。还有，Tsuneyo 那次很奇怪，我觉得那个不算。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk10
: What about Yasu? Because omitting her implies you two have kissed already and I would very much like to know what sort of development led to that.
lines.zh: : 那 Yasu 呢？因为漏掉她意味着你俩已经亲过了，我非常想知道是什么样的发展导致了那一步。

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah, no. I haven’t kissed her either. I just don’t really think about her sexually outside of very specific, spontaneous contexts so I didn’t even think about including her there.
lines.zh: : 哦。对，没有。我也没亲过她。我只是除了非常特定、非常即兴的情境之外，基本不会往性那方面想她，所以我压根没想到要把她算进去。

lines.en: : You should kiss me in more spontaneous contexts. Like when I’m at dinner with my parents. That’d be a really funny reunion.
lines.zh: : 你应该在更多即兴的情境下亲我。比如我跟父母吃饭的时候。那会是一次非常搞笑的重逢。

lines.en: : I think we have vastly different ideas of what is and isn’t funny, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们对什么好笑、什么不好笑的看法大不相同，Noriko。

lines.en: : Have you ever even laughed before? Cause I sure as fuck ain’t seen it.
lines.zh: : 你到底笑过没有？反正我他妈的是没见过。

lines.en: : Me neither, now that I think about it. And you’ve fucked my mouth.
lines.zh: : 我想想，我也没见过。而你还操过我的嘴。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk11
: Ew! The fuck does that have to do with anything?!
lines.zh: : 呕！这跟那件事有什么关系？！

lines.en: : Nothing really. I just wanted to brag for a second to let you know whose man you will be thieving if you try to make a move after I leave.
lines.zh: : 其实没什么关系。我只是想炫耀一下，让你知道等我走了之后，你要是动手，偷的是谁的男人。

lines.en: : Leave? Where are you going? I need a bodyguard if I’m going to be around Yumi.
lines.zh: : 走？你要去哪儿？我要是跟 Yumi 待在一起，需要一个保镖。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk12
: I’m going to the movies with Kirin. But hey, Tsuneyo is only a couple blocks away if you find yourself in trouble. Maybe she can help?
lines.zh: : 我要跟 Kirin 去看电影。不过嘿，你要是遇上麻烦，Tsuneyo 就在几条街之外。也许她能帮忙？

lines.en: : You’re going to leave Yumi alone here?
lines.zh: : 你要把 Yumi 一个人留在这儿？

lines.en: : I work alone all the time, asshole. I’m like, actually responsible now and shit.
lines.zh: : 我一直都是一个人上班的，混蛋。我现在可是真的很有责任心了什么的。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk13
: Besides, we’re closing for some renovation bullshit in like an hour anyway. I just gotta mop or whatever.
lines.zh: : 再说，反正再过一个小时我们就要因为装修什么的关门了。我就拖个地什么的。

lines.en: : Bring her back to me in one piece. Okay, Onii-chan? She’s going to be one of my bridesmaids one day.
lines.zh: : 把她完好无损地带回来给我。好吗，欧尼酱？她将来会是我的伴娘之一。

lines.en: : So will Kirin I imagine, but you’ve never told me to bring {i}her{/i} back in one piece.
lines.zh: : 我猜 Kirin 也是，不过你从来没叫我把{i}她{/i}完好地带回来。

lines.en: : Well, duh. Kirin’s the kind of girl you’re {i}supposed{/i} to break.
lines.zh: : 那当然啦。Kirin 是那种你{i}本来就该{/i}弄坏的女孩子。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk14
: That said- I’m probably gonna be late, so I’ve gotta go! Be good, you two! And in the event that you {i}aren’t,{/i} record what happens and show me later! Bye-bye! Love you both!
lines.zh: : 话说回来——我大概要迟到了，所以我得走了！你们俩乖一点！要是{i}不乖{/i}，就把发生的事录下来，回头给我看！拜拜！爱你们俩！

lines.en: : Love you-
lines.zh: : 爱你——

lines.en: : Do not speak such words around me even if they are directed at someone else.
lines.zh: : 别在我面前说这种话，哪怕你不是在跟我说。

lines.en: : You’re going to make a terrible bridesmaid.
lines.zh: : 你会是个糟糕透顶的伴娘。

lines.en: : {i}You don’t say.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你还别说。{/i}

lines.en: : So, how are things?
lines.zh: : 那么，最近怎么样？

lines.en: : Yumi?
lines.zh: : Yumi？

lines.en: : What? You came all the way to a fucking convenience store in the Old District to not buy anything and you’re confused about why I’m not acting all buddy-buddy with you?
lines.zh: : 什么？你大老远跑到老城区一家破便利店来，什么都不买，然后还奇怪我为什么不跟你称兄道弟？

lines.en: : Hey, beats coming over here for the sole purpose of contemplating throwing myself off a bridge.
lines.zh: : 嘿，总比专门跑来这儿琢磨着从桥上跳下去强。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk15
: Now, I don’t know if I’d go that far. I say you go give it a shot so we can know for sure.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这我倒不敢说。我说你去试试呗，这样我们就确定了。

lines.en: : You’d be upset and you know it.
lines.zh: : 你会难过的，你知道的。

lines.en: : Ehh. I’d get over it in like a week.
lines.zh: : 呃。我大概一周就走出来了。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk16
: Might help prepare me for my mom’s death too. So for all we know, you could be doin’ me a favor by dying. You’d sure as fuck be doing a favor to a bunch of other people.
lines.zh: : 说不定还能帮我预习我妈的死呢。所以说不定你死了反而是帮我忙。对别的一堆人来说，你肯定是帮了大忙。

lines.en: : So, about that time you kissed me on the cheek in a love hotel-
lines.zh: : 那么，关于你在情趣酒店亲我脸颊那次——

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk17
: No! {i}Not{/i} about that time! You drop that shit right now and just...help me fucking mop or something!
lines.zh: : 不！{i}不是{/i}关于那次！你他妈的现在就给我打住，然后……过来帮我拖地什么的！

lines.en: : If I help you mop, will you let me walk you home afterward?
lines.zh: : 要是我帮你拖地，你让我之后送你回家吗？

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk18
: Sure, yeah. Whatever. I guess that’s...fine.
lines.zh: : 行，好啊。随你便。我想那……也行吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, I had a feeling you wouldn’t-
lines.zh: : 是啊，我就知道你不会——

lines.en: : Wait what? Did you...did you actually just agree to that?
lines.zh: : 等等什么？你……你真的刚刚同意了？

lines.en: : Depends. Are you going to immediately make me regret it?
lines.zh: : 看情况。你会不会马上让我后悔？

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk19
: Well, don’t just fucking stand there or I definitely {i}will{/i} regret it! You had every opportunity to not make this shit weird and you’re already fucking that up!
lines.zh: : 喂，别他妈的杵在那儿，不然我肯定{i}会{/i}后悔！你明明有机会不让这事变得恶心的，可你已经他妈的在搞砸了！

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. Yeah. That just...caught me off guard.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。是啊。只是……太出乎我意料了。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk20
: Yeah, well...you don’t stalk me even half as much as you used to anymore, so just...see it as a one-time thank you for, like...actually leaving me alone and shit...
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个……你现在也不像以前那样跟踪我了，连一半都不到，所以就……当成一次一次性的感谢吧，谢谢你……真的放过我了什么的……

lines.en: : The mop’s in the back room, by the way.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，拖把在后面的房间里。

lines.en: : Oh. You’re, like...you actually want me to mop.
lines.zh: : 哦。你……是真的要我去拖地。

lines.en: : And make sure you don’t miss anything since the contractors will be here in a couple hours.
lines.zh: : 而且别漏掉任何地方，承包商再过几个小时就到了。

lines.en: : Thanks, Sensei. I knew I could count on you.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Sensei。我就知道能指望你。

lines.en: : You’re lucky I have a thing for girls who are mean to me.
lines.zh: : 幸好我就喜欢对我凶的女生。

lines.en: : And {i}you’re{/i} lucky I’m a fucking moron. Now go, like...do shit before I regret this even more. And stop looking at me, already. It’s embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 而{i}你{/i}也幸好我是个他妈的傻子。现在去……干活吧，趁我还没更后悔。还有别再看我了，行吗。太丢人了。

lines.en: : Because you’re blushing?
lines.zh: : 因为你脸红了？

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk21
: Y...Yeah...
Oh my god.
lines.zh: 我的天啊。

lines.en: scene black
Not wanting to ruin the moment for what may very well be the first time in my life, I make my way into the back room and manage to find the mop closet.
lines.zh: 我这辈子大概头一回不想毁掉这个瞬间，于是我走进后面的房间，总算找到了放拖把的柜子。

lines.en: But by the time I get back, Yumi is nowhere to be found and the sign on the door has been switched to “Closed.”
lines.zh: 可等我回来，Yumi 已经不见了，门上的牌子也翻到了「休息中」。

lines.en: Now, am I {i}surprised{/i} that she would just trick me into closing the store like this so she could bail without me? Not at all.
lines.zh: 那么，她就这么耍我、让我替她把店关了、然后好自己溜走，我{i}意外{/i}吗？一点也不。

lines.en: But I’m going to go out on a limb here and say it was all worth it because-
lines.zh: 不过我敢大胆说一句，这一切都值了，因为——

lines.en: : Did you put the right shit in there? You’ve gotta use the soap first and then go over it again with sanitizing shit after.
lines.zh: : 你放对东西了吗？得先上肥皂水，然后再用消毒的东西过一遍。

lines.en: : Oh. You’re still here?
lines.zh: : 哦。你还在这儿？

lines.en: : Uhh...yeah? You think I’d just fucking leave this place to somebody like you? That ain’t how this shit works, dude. You’ve gotta, like...earn trust and whatnot before you can be alone here. And that’s-
lines.zh: : 呃……对啊？你觉得我会把这种地方丢给你这样的人？这事不是这么运作的，老兄。你得……先赢得信任什么的，才能一个人待在这儿。而这——

lines.en: : See, yeah. You already fucked up. You need to dump that out and fill it with the soapy shit instead. Want me to show you?
lines.zh: : 看吧，对。你已经搞砸了。你得把那倒掉，换成肥皂水。要我教你吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...o...okay. Sure.
lines.zh: : 呃……好……好吧。当然。

lines.en: Uhh...
Yumi teaches me how to mop?
lines.zh: Yumi 教我怎么拖地？

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk22
And then we’re...back outside. And I’m walking her home.
lines.zh: 然后我们就……回到外面。而我正送她回家。

lines.en: This is a totally and completely normal night that I definitely predicted when I decided to head over to the convenience store.
lines.zh: 这是一个完全正常的夜晚，在我决定去便利店的时候，我百分百预测到了。

lines.en: : The fuck do you keep looking at me like that for?
lines.zh: : 你他妈的一直那样看着我干嘛？

lines.en: : Yumi...do you have cancer too?
lines.zh: : Yumi……你也得癌症了吗？

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk23
: What?! I fucking {i}hope{/i} not! Why?! Does it...can you tell? Does it {i}look{/i} like I have it? Because I know that shit can be genetic or whatever, but-
lines.zh: : 什么？！我他妈的{i}希望{/i}没有！为什么？！难道……你看得出来？我{i}看起来{/i}像有吗？因为我知道那玩意可能会遗传什么的，但是——

lines.en: : It’s not like that. You’re just being unusually {i}warm{/i} to me now that Noriko’s gone. I’m not...really used to that from you, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不是那样。只是 Noriko 走了之后，你对我异常地{i}热情{/i}。我大概……不太习惯你这样。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk24
: Oh. Well...yeah.
lines.zh: : 哦。那个……是啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess that would probably seem pretty weird if you weren’t expecting it. But, like...like, it’s not like I’m {i}always{/i} a bitch to you, right?
lines.zh: : 是啊，你要是没料到，大概确实挺怪的。但是，就像……就像，我又不是{i}一直{/i}对你很凶，对吧？

lines.en: : Like...when all that shit went down with my mom, you were there for me. And, so...like...
lines.zh: : 就像……我妈出事那阵子，你在我身边。所以……就像……

lines.en: : I don’t know. I just figured we were kinda...{i}different{/i} now. A lot’s happened and...and yeah. Just...a lot’s happened.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我就是觉得我们现在有点……{i}不一样{/i}了。发生了很多事，而且……而且对。就是……发生了很多事。

lines.en: : You’re okay then? Not going to suddenly die on me?
lines.zh: : 那你还好吗？不会突然丢下我死掉吧？

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk25
: Not if I have any control over it...hahah...hah...
lines.zh: : 只要我能控制就不会……哈哈……哈……

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk26
: Hah...
Well, would you look at this?
lines.zh: 哎呀，你瞧瞧？

lines.en: It appears that all it took to chip away at the seemingly unbreakable shell that covered Yumi was being in the right place at the wrong time.
lines.zh: 看来，要敲碎裹在 Yumi 身上那层看似坚不可摧的壳，只需要在错误的时间出现在正确的地点。

lines.en: And no, it’s not like I’m {i}confident{/i} that I’ve finally got her hooked now that she’s nibbling the bait, but...
lines.zh: 不，我不是说现在她开始咬饵了，我就{i}确信{/i}自己终于把她钓住了，可是……

lines.en: I’ve been out at sea for a long time. And I’ve gotten so bored at failing to catch any fish in the depths of these peaceful waters that just the company of one is enough to bring me joy for now.
lines.zh: 我在海上漂了很久。在这片平静水域的深处，我一条鱼也钓不到，无聊到了极点，所以现在哪怕只有一条鱼作伴，也足够让我开心一阵子了。

lines.en: How unfortunate that such joy is once again laced with a tinge of tragedy, but I suppose that’s how these things always are.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，这份喜悦又一次掺进了一丝悲剧的味道，不过我想这些事向来如此。

lines.en: It’s hard to look up while you’re falling. So chances are Yumi became so accustomed to her endless descent that she’d all but given up on the prospects of ascension and light as a whole.
lines.zh: 坠落的时候很难抬头。所以 Yumi 大概是太习惯自己无止境的下坠了，几乎彻底放弃了上升和光明的可能性。

lines.en: So at the bottom of the well she’d fallen to...when she was finally able to take a look at the place she’d landed, she must have mistaken me for the sun as I peered over the ledge to call out to her.
lines.zh: 于是，在她掉进的那口井底……当她终于能看清自己落到的地方时，她一定把我错认成了太阳——我从井口探出头去喊她的时候。

lines.en: I, too, made that same mistake once. And there’s not a day that’s gone by that I haven’t paid for it.
lines.zh: 我也犯过同样的错。而没有一天我不在为此付出代价。

lines.en: But, at the same time...there’s not a day that goes by where I don’t want it back.
lines.zh: 但与此同时……也没有一天我不想把它找回来。

lines.en: Youth is such a funny thing. How impressionable. How {i}pure.{/i}
lines.zh: 青春真是个滑稽的东西。多么容易受外界影响。多么{i}纯粹。{/i}

lines.en: When you get to my age, everyone’s just sludge. Walking masses of scar tissue from all the times we’ve been burned, overflowing with guilt and decay that we try to wish away in the mirror but {i}can’t.{/i}
lines.zh: 到了我这个年纪，每个人都只是烂泥。一堆会走路的瘢痕组织，来自我们所有被灼伤的时刻，满溢着愧疚与腐朽，我们想在镜子里把它们许愿掉，却{i}做不到{/i}。

lines.en: When she looks, she sees a hairpin.
lines.zh: 而她照镜子的时候，看到的是一枚发夹。

lines.en: No guilt. No decay. No scars or burns or sludge at all.
lines.zh: 没有愧疚。没有腐朽。一点疤痕、灼伤或烂泥都没有。

lines.en: And I love that.
lines.zh: 而我爱这一点。

lines.en: I love that she can decorate herself. That she still sees color in all of this.
lines.zh: 我爱她还能装饰自己。爱她在这一切之中依然看得见颜色。

lines.en: It makes me want to saturate her.
lines.zh: 这让我想把她浸满色彩。

lines.en: : We’ve really come a long way, haven’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们真的走了很远了，不是吗？

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk27
: Huh?
: Or I guess {i}you’ve{/i} come a long way.
lines.zh: : 或者应该说，是{i}你{/i}走了很远。

lines.en: : It feels like just the other day we were beginning the Yumi Revitalization Project. Where you didn’t even understand what “sex” meant on job applications and I had to teach you myself.
lines.zh: : 感觉就像前几天我们才刚开始「Yumi 复兴计划」。那时候你连求职申请表上的「性」是什么意思都不懂，还得我亲自教你。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk28
: Why do you even remember that? That was so long ago.
lines.zh: : 你怎么还记得那个？那都多久以前了。

lines.en: : You remember it too, obviously.
lines.zh: : 你显然也记得啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, because {i}I{/i} was embarrassed. It’s much easier remembering shit like that when you’re the one it happens to.
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为{i}我{/i}当时很丢人。发生在自己身上的事，总是更容易记住。

lines.en: : It’s all in the past now. Like I said, you’ve come a long way.
lines.zh: : 那都是过去的事了。就像我说的，你走了很远。

lines.en: : You’ve got a job now. You’ve got an apartment — albeit one that sort of fell into your lap. But still, you’ve done some stuff with the place. You even bought curtains. {i}I’ve{/i} never bought curtains.
lines.zh: : 你现在有工作了。你有公寓了——虽然有点像是天上掉下来的。但还是，你把那地方收拾出了点样子。你甚至买了窗帘。{i}我{/i}从来没买过窗帘。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk29
: You’ve got Noriko now. Even if you don’t want her. And you’ve got your mom too. Even if you don’t want to admit that.
lines.zh: : 你现在有 Noriko 了。就算你不想要她。你也有你妈了。就算你不愿意承认。

lines.en: : And you.
lines.zh: : 还有你。

lines.en: : Me?
: Yeah. Like...I can be with you without fearing for my life anymore.
lines.zh: : 嗯。就像……我现在跟你在一起，不用再担心自己的小命了。

lines.en: : I...trust you. As weird as that is to say after you literally sexually assaulted me.
lines.zh: : 我……信任你。尽管在你真的性侵过我之后说这话很怪。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk30
: That was-
lines.zh: : 那次是——

lines.en: : Complicated. I know.
lines.zh: : 很复杂。我知道。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk31
: But what isn’t these days?
lines.zh: : 可这年头有什么不复杂？

lines.en: : Time loops...apocalypses...mind-bending paranormal {i}god{/i} things that make me fear for my life before puking me right back out into this cesspool of a city...
lines.zh: : 时间循环……世界末日……那些扭曲心智的超自然{i}神明{/i}玩意，先吓得我半死，再把我吐回这座臭水沟一样的城市……

lines.en: : Comin’ around to trusting you after how shit started off is, like...the {i}least{/i} crazy thing that’s happened to me over the last few years.
lines.zh: : 在开局那么烂之后慢慢开始信任你，大概是……这几年来发生在我身上{i}最不{/i}疯狂的事了。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk32
: Besides, you throwin’ yourself at me taught me I just always need to be prepared to kick you in the balls if you try it again.
lines.zh: : 再说，你扑过来那次教会了我，只要随时准备好你再敢来就踹你卵蛋就行。

lines.en: : Which you will. Because your brain is apparently just as fucked up as this whole damn world.
lines.zh: : 而你会再来的。因为你的脑子显然跟这个该死的世界一样坏掉了。

lines.en: : Guess life ain’t all that different from manga at the end of the day. There’s plenty of reality-defying shit out there. You’ve just gotta wait for it to come to you instead of going out to look for it.
lines.zh: : 我猜人生到头来跟漫画也没什么两样。世上多的是违背现实的破事。你只要等着它自己找上门，而不是出门去找它。

lines.en: : That {i}has{/i} seemed to work lately. Little by little, our team is expanding. And soon enough, we’ll {i}all{/i} be in this together.
lines.zh: : 这招最近似乎挺管用的。一点一点地，我们的队伍在扩大。用不了多久，我们就会{i}全都{/i}卷进来了。

lines.en: : Hope you’re wrong. I kinda like how it is now. The thought of more people gettin’ involved just makes me want to go back to normal.
lines.zh: : 希望你说错了。我还挺喜欢现在的样子。一想到有更多人卷进来，我就想回到正常。

lines.en: : But if you go back to normal, we won’t have such a weird and paranormal thing in common anymore. Plus, if you get reset, I’ll have to start all over with you and redo all of the progress we’ve made.
lines.zh: : 可你要是回到正常，我们就不再有这件诡异又超自然的共同经历了。再说，你要是被重置了，我就得从头再来一遍，把我们取得的进展全重做一次。

lines.en: : Guess it’d be kind of annoying from my POV too. You’re way more bearable now that I know you’re a {i}helpless{/i} loser instead of a {i}hopeless{/i} loser.
lines.zh: : 从我角度看大概也挺烦的。现在我知道你是个{i}无助{/i}的废物、而不是{i}没救{/i}的废物，你倒好忍受多了。

lines.en: : Hey, you’re kind of a loser too, you know. We’re both pretty terrible people at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你也是个废物，你知道的。说到底我们俩都挺糟糕的。

lines.en: : Damn right. Think we’re both pretty content with not getting any better too based on our track records.
lines.zh: : 说得对。看我们的前科，我猜我们都挺满足于不再变好的。

lines.en: : I’m worse, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我更糟。

lines.en: : Way worse. I ain’t a sketchy rapist who’s probably thinking about how to get invited into some teenager’s apartment right now.
lines.zh: : 糟多了。我可不是那种可疑的强奸犯，现在大概还在琢磨怎么被请进某个少女的公寓。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk33
: I think I left something in your pants.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我把什么东西落在你裤子里了。

lines.en: : You mean my room?
lines.zh: : 你是说在我房间？

lines.en: : Yes. What did I say?
lines.zh: : 对。我说什么了？

lines.en: : Thanks for walking me home. Now, get the fuck out of here before I call the cops and tell ‘em some stalker’s harassing me again.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你送我回家。现在趁我还没报警说有个跟踪狂又来骚扰我，赶紧他妈的滚吧。

lines.en: : You’re smiling a lot today.
lines.zh: : 你今天笑得很多。

lines.en: : And you’re stalling.
lines.zh: : 而你在拖时间。

lines.en: : I don’t want to go home.
lines.zh: : 我不想回家。

lines.en: : Because you’ve got an incestuous future-serial killer living there?
lines.zh: : 因为家里住着一个乱伦的未来连环杀手？

lines.en: : Because I know you’ll stop smiling.
lines.zh: : 因为我知道我一走你就不笑了。

lines.en: : You {i}would{/i} think my happiness is entirely dependent on your presence. It’s not, dumbass.
lines.zh: : 你大概{i}以为{/i}我的幸福完全取决于你在不在。才不是呢，蠢货。

lines.en: : You’re okay then? With everything going on with your mom and Chika and having to hold down a job and-
lines.zh: : 那你还好吗？你妈那边的事、Chika 的事、还得保住一份工作，还有——

lines.en: : And the fact that I’ll probably never grow old and that there’s a weird sarcastic voice inside of my head dead-set on making my life a living hell? Yeah. I’m okay.
lines.zh: : 还有我大概永远长不大，还有我脑子里有个爱挖苦的怪声音一门心思要让我生不如死？对。我还好。

lines.en: : Let me know if you start hearing theme music. That’s how I’ll know it’s gotten really bad.
lines.zh: : 要是你开始听见主题曲，记得告诉我。那样我就知道真的糟透了。

lines.en: : We’ll see. I’m saving your presence for all of the shit I {i}can’t{/i} handle on my own. There ain’t much that fits that bill, though.
lines.zh: : 走着瞧吧。我把「找你」留给我一个人{i}扛不住{/i}的事。不过符合那条标准的事可不多。

lines.en: : Is it wrong for me to say I hope someone else you love gets sick so I can spend the night with you again?
lines.zh: : 我说希望再多一个你爱的人生病，好让我能再陪你过一夜，是不是很过分？

lines.en: : Very fucking wrong. Yes.
lines.zh: : 非常他妈的过分。是的。

lines.en: : Got it. I’ll probably just leave then.
lines.zh: : 明白了。那我大概要走了。

lines.en: : And I’ll probably go upstairs and pass the fuck out. Night.
lines.zh: : 而我大概要上楼昏死过去了。晚安。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Yumi. Call me if you need anything.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Yumi。有什么需要就给我打电话。

lines.en: : No thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢了，不用。

lines.en: scene black
: This was more than enough {i}you{/i} for the rest of the year, I think...
lines.zh: : 我觉得今年剩下时间里，{i}你{/i}已经够多了……

lines.en: I turn to leave, having successfully escorted Yumi back to her apartment without anything weird happening.
lines.zh: 我转身离开，成功地把 Yumi 送回了她的公寓，没有发生任何奇怪的事。

lines.en: Well...apart from the fact that our relationship is just comparably weird now given how it’s been in the past.
lines.zh: 嗯……除了我们这段关系比起过去，现在只能用「同样奇怪」来形容。

lines.en: That’s the type of “weird” I can’t get enough of, though. And if you were to ask me what I think about what it means for the future, I’d say-
lines.zh: 不过，那种「奇怪」我是怎么都尝不够的。要是你问我，这对未来意味着什么，我会说——

lines.en: : Actually...
lines.zh: : 其实……

lines.en: : Huh?
: Do you want to come inside?...
lines.zh: : 你要不要进来？……

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk34
: J...Just for like...tea or whatever. I...I just realized you never bought anything from the konbini and...it’s kind of a long walk, so...I’d feel, like...bad and shit if you just left now...
lines.zh: : 就……就喝杯茶什么的。我……我刚想起来你什么都没在便利店买，而且……路挺远的，所以……你要是就这么走了，我会觉得……挺过意不去的什么的……

lines.en: : Cute romance song...
lines.zh: : 可爱的恋爱BGM……

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk35
: C-Cut it out with the fucking background soundtrack shit! This ain’t some kind of fucking rom-com!
lines.zh: : 别、别他妈的搞那套背景音乐了！这不是什么该死的爱情喜剧！

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk36
: Sorry. I couldn’t help it. It felt like one for a second.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我忍不住。有那么一瞬间感觉就像。

lines.en: I’ll just use a softer one instead. This way she won’t know.
lines.zh: 那我就换一首柔和点的。这样她就不会发现了。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk37
: You don’t need to apologize or whatever, just...either come or don’t come. I don’t really care either way. Just...wanted to give you the option.
lines.zh: : 你不用道歉什么的，就是……要么进来要么不进。我怎样都无所谓。只是……想给你这个选择。

lines.en: : Are you sure? It’s late. Don’t you need to wake up early for school tomorrow?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？很晚了。你明天不是还得早起上学吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. So? Not like that’s ever really been at the top of the priority list for me.
lines.zh: : 是啊。那又怎样？那玩意从来都排不上我优先级的前面。

lines.en: : No. And I didn’t think {i}I{/i} was either, but-
lines.zh: : 是。而且{i}我{/i}也以为自己排不上，不过——

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk38
: Ugh...forget it, actually. I don’t know what I was thinking inviting some fucking predator into my-
lines.zh: : 呃……算了，其实。我不知道自己当时在想什么，居然邀请一个他妈的捕食者进我的——

lines.en: : Sure, Yumi. I’ll come up for a drink.
lines.zh: : 好啊，Yumi。我上去喝一杯。

lines.en: scene yumikonbiniwalk39
: Y...Yeah?...You will?
lines.zh: : 好……真的？……你会？

lines.en: : Yeah. I will.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我会。

lines.en: : Then I...uhh...
: I might not...have any tea, actually...
lines.zh: : 我可能……其实没有茶……

lines.en: : It might just...be water.
lines.zh: : 可能……只有水。

lines.en: : Sorry, I...wasn’t really thinking when I-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我……刚才真的没想那么多——

lines.en: : Anything is fine. It doesn’t matter.
lines.zh: : 什么都行。不重要。

lines.en: : Okay. There still...like I {i}might{/i} have it. I just don’t remember off the top of my head.
lines.zh: : 好。还是……我{i}可能{/i}有的。我只是一下子想不起来。

lines.en: : Are you the one stalling now? Have we switched places?
lines.zh: : 现在换你在拖时间了？我们换位置了？

lines.en: : You’re really coming in?
lines.zh: : 你真的要进来？

lines.en: : Are you having second thoughts?
lines.zh: : 你后悔了？

lines.en: : No...But I was...barely having {i}first{/i} thoughts either, so...
lines.zh: : 没有……不过我刚才也几乎是没{i}想过{/i}就开口了，所以……
: 那么……

lines.en: scene black
: Lead the way...
lines.zh: : 带路吧……

$ yumi_love += 1
{i}Yumi’s affection has increased to [yumi_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yumi 的好感度提升到了 [yumi_love]!{/i}
